readings: Which events have an above-average budget amount? For each event (`budget.link_to_event`), using the average `amount` across its budget lines and ignoring missing amounts, show the event link, its average amount, how much it beats the overall average budget amount, and its average minus the mean among those above-average events. List the top 10 by that last gap, largest first.
queries:
WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS average_amount
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
above_average_events AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event,
        average_amount,
        average_amount - (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget) AS above_overall_average
    FROM event_averages
    WHERE average_amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM budget)
)
SELECT
    link_to_event,
    average_amount,
    above_overall_average,
    average_amount - (SELECT AVG(average_amount) FROM above_average_events) AS gap_from_above_average_mean
FROM above_average_events
ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
